_readme: The day's program. status: 'tentative' shows a 'program coming soon' notice; 'final' removes it. showSessions: false shows only the framework (start, lunch, end) until the committee is ready to publish session titles; flip it to true to reveal the sessions below. Times are in the event timezone (site.json → event.timezone). Keep sessions in order. legacy: recovery | unity | service | all. kind: opening | talk | session | break | workshop | closing.
note: The full program is being woven together by the planning committee and will be posted here. Expect three legacy-focused sessions, a shared lunch break, and a closing panel that ties all 36 threads together.

sessions.title: Welcome & opening
sessions.summary: Serenity Prayer, the A.A. Preamble, and how the day will work (interpretation channels, breaks, questions).

sessions.title: Keynote: One Fellowship, Three Legacies
sessions.summary: Why Bill W. called Recovery, Unity and Service our Three Legacies, and how a single thread runs through the Step, Tradition and Concept of the same number.

sessions.title: Recovery: the Twelve Steps as a way of life
sessions.summary: Speaker and sharing. How the Steps shape the person who shows up for the group and for service.

sessions.title: Unity: the Twelve Traditions in the room and on the screen
sessions.summary: Speaker, situations from real groups, and a look at how each Tradition answers the Step of the same number.

sessions.title: Lunch break
sessions.summary: Thirty minutes. The Zoom room stays open; interpreters rest too.

sessions.title: Service: the Twelve Concepts, plainly
sessions.summary: Speaker and Q&A. The Concepts without the jargon: how the Fellowship governs itself and why it matters to a home group.

sessions.title: Weaving the 36 together
sessions.summary: Small-group breakouts: each room takes one number and traces its thread through Step, Tradition and Concept, then reports back.

sessions.title: Closing panel & the Responsibility Statement
sessions.summary: Panel reflections, announcements, and a closing that sends us back to our home groups.
